L2: Planning, Logical Reasoning, Working Memory, Adaptive Error Correction (minor)
L3: Inhibitory Control (minor)

Cognitive Functions:
L1: 
L2: Planning, Logical Reasoning, Working Memory, Semantic Understanding & Context Recognition (minor)
L3: Cognitive Flexibility
